evidence.title: Body Condition Report
evidence.playerSummary: The body condition does not cleanly match a death after 21:00.
evidence.technicalNote: Cooling and stiffness are inconsistent with the apparent late activity window.

evidence.title: Thermostat / AC Log
evidence.playerSummary: The apartment was cooled unusually after the real murder window began.
evidence.technicalNote: AC dropped sharply at 19:34, which can distort body-temperature interpretation.

evidence.title: Broken Vase / Disturbed Table
evidence.playerSummary: There was a short localized struggle near the body.
evidence.technicalNote: The disturbance is concentrated, suggesting an impulsive escalation rather than a long fight.

evidence.title: Blood-Marked Company Award
evidence.playerSummary: The company award is likely the murder weapon.
evidence.technicalNote: Blood marking and impact position connect the object to the fatal struggle.

evidence.title: Smart-Lock Entry / Exit Log
evidence.playerSummary: The partner arrived at 19:05 and exited at 19:42.
evidence.technicalNote: The access log looks clean, but it only clears him if the victim was alive later.

evidence.title: Scheduled Victim Message
evidence.playerSummary: A message sent at 21:07 appears to show the victim was alive, but metadata suggests it was scheduled.
evidence.technicalNote: The message was queued before delivery, so the send time is not proof of manual activity.

evidence.title: Laptop Session Metadata
evidence.playerSummary: Laptop activity continued after the likely death time, but the interaction pattern looks automated.
evidence.technicalNote: Session metadata shows repeated timed actions rather than varied manual input.

evidence.title: Router / Admin Access Record
evidence.playerSummary: A trusted admin-level session accessed apartment systems around the staging period.
evidence.technicalNote: The session had privileged access to networked apartment devices, not just ordinary remote viewing.

evidence.title: Wife Remote Access Log
evidence.playerSummary: The wife remotely checked apartment systems at 20:18, after the true murder window.
evidence.technicalNote: The access is real, but it falls inside the false post-death window and does not explain the earlier violence.

evidence.title: CCTV Outage Note
evidence.playerSummary: A building camera outage at 20:40 makes security look suspicious inside the false window.
evidence.technicalNote: The outage complicates the record, but it occurs after the true murder and does not create the staged device activity.

evidence.title: Access-Data Sale File
evidence.playerSummary: Victim and partner were involved in illegal access-data activity.
evidence.technicalNote: The file lists paid transfers tied to apartment-system access data.

evidence.title: Victim Draft Disclosure Email
evidence.playerSummary: Victim intended to expose or withdraw from the illegal operation.
evidence.technicalNote: The unsent draft names the operation and implies the partner would be legally exposed.

threads.name: Death Window Instability
threads.coreQuestion: When did the victim actually die?
threads.stabilizedConclusion: The death window was distorted. The victim likely died before the post-21:00 activity.

threads.name: Postmortem Activity
threads.coreQuestion: Why did the victim appear active after death?
threads.stabilizedConclusion: The victim's digital activity was artificially continued after death.

threads.name: Apartment Access
threads.coreQuestion: Who could affect the apartment physically or remotely?
threads.stabilizedConclusion: Several people had suspicious access, but the full manipulation required trusted technical privileges.

threads.name: Data-Sale Motive
threads.coreQuestion: Why would the partner escalate to violence?
threads.stabilizedConclusion: The victim was preparing to expose an illegal operation the partner depended on.

threads.name: Scene Disturbance
threads.coreQuestion: Was this planned, staged, or impulsive?
threads.stabilizedConclusion: The killing was an impulsive escalation followed by a calculated cover-up.

timelineEvents.title: Victim Activity Window
timelineEvents.initialInterpretation: Message and laptop activity initially suggest the victim was alive after 21:00.
timelineEvents.resolvedInterpretation: Physical evidence and environmental logs make the post-21:00 activity unreliable as proof of life.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Scheduled message sends
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The late message is delivered, but it is no longer proof the victim was alive.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Partner exits
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The partner leaves after staging the apartment systems.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Murder occurs
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The argument turns violent in the living room.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Body discovered
finalTimelineEvents.summary: Security finds the body during the welfare check.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Partner arrives
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The business partner enters for a private meeting.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Wife remote access
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The wife checks apartment systems after the victim is already dead.

finalTimelineEvents.title: AC and smart-home staging begins
finalTimelineEvents.summary: Cooling and automated activity start shaping the false death window.

finalTimelineEvents.title: CCTV outage
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The camera outage complicates the record but does not explain the murder.

finalTimelineEvents.title: Argument escalates
finalTimelineEvents.summary: The victim says he intends to expose the access-data operation.

statements.speaker: Business Partner
statements.claim: We argued, but he was alive when I left. He was already back at his laptop.
statements.suspiciousDetail: His claim depends on the victim being alive after the 19:42 exit.
statements.contradictionText: The stabilized death-window contradiction weakens his claimed alibi.

statements.speaker: Elena Voss
statements.claim: I checked the apartment system because he stopped answering. I never went there.
statements.suspiciousDetail: Her remote access sits inside the original false death window.
statements.contradictionText: Resolved: her access happened after the true murder window and does not explain the staged continuity.

statements.speaker: Building Security
statements.claim: The camera issue was maintenance. I checked on him because the system flagged irregular activity.
statements.suspiciousDetail: The outage timing makes security look close to the apparent death window.
statements.contradictionText: Resolved: the outage complicates the record, but the murder and staging began earlier.

rooms.debugContextText: Victim: Adrian Voss. Physical clues define the real violence.
Visitor log: Marcus Hale entered 19:05 and exited 19:42.
Environmental systems contradict the apparent late death window.
Victim laptop and network devices expose staging and motive.
Building security context. Useful later for staff suspicion.

panels.label: Messages
contentLines: Finding: this message is not reliable proof the victim was alive at 21:07.

panels.label: Activity
contentLines: Finding: activity pattern resembles automation, not normal human use.

panels.label: Files
contentLines: Finding: sale records connect the company to illegal apartment-system access data.

panels.label: Draft
contentLines: Finding: victim intended to expose the access-data operation.

lines.speaker: Investigator
lines.text: The late activity was not proof of life. It was continuity staged after the killing.

lines.speaker: Marcus Hale
lines.text: You are building a story out of logs you barely understand.

lines.speaker: Investigator
lines.text: The logs are exactly the problem. The thermostat shifted at 19:34. The laptop repeated timed actions. The 21:07 message was scheduled.

lines.speaker: Marcus Hale
lines.text: He was going to destroy everything. He was going to hand it all over.

lines.speaker: Investigator
lines.text: You entered at 19:05. The argument escalated. He died before your clean exit became useful.

lines.speaker: Marcus Hale
lines.text: I only needed time. Just enough time for everyone to look later.

lines.speaker: Investigator
lines.text: That is what gives you away. You did not erase the timeline. You made it too precise.

caseCompletion.title: Case Closed
caseCompletion.body: The false timeline collapses. Marcus Hale killed Adrian Voss earlier than the systems implied, then used precise machine records to make a dead man appear active. The remaining suspects were suspicious because the manipulated window made them matter.
